# PAP India (Property Aligners & Planners)

> Mall management consultancy operating across India. PAP India plans, leases, launches and operates malls, high streets and mixed-use retail assets: mall operations, leasing and zoning, pre-construction feasibility and planning support, launch marketing and ongoing sustenance and reporting. Portfolio of 5.2 million sq ft across retail, commercial and cinemas.

## Services

- **Research & feasibility**: Understanding what the catchment actually supports before a single lease is signed.
- **Leasing & zoning**: Building the mix, then closing it: collateral, outreach, paperwork and onboarding.
- **Operations & technology**: The systems and people that keep the asset running from day one.
- **Marketing & launch**: Getting the opening right, then keeping footfall coming back.
- **Sustenance & reporting**: Ongoing visibility for owners and investors, quarter after quarter.

## Approach

Four phases in sequence: need gap analysis, pre-launch preparations, launch phase, sustenance. Engagements are scoped by phase: land/concept, pre-launch, launch, operational asset or turnaround.

## Key projects

- **Wave One, Noida** (Mixed use, Noida): 3.53 acres · 40 storeys
- **Wave Mall, Ludhiana** (Mall, Ludhiana): 2.85 lakh sq ft GLA
- **Wave Mall, Jammu** (Mall, Jammu): 2.80 lakh sq ft GLA
- **Wave One Club** (Lifestyle, Noida): 50,000 sq ft
- **Aero District** (Retail, Ludhiana): Phase 1 - 2.6 L sqft
- **Vardhman Amrante** (Mall, Ludhiana): 2.7 lakh sq ft
- **Sabarmati HSR Hub** (Transit-oriented, Sabarmati, Gujarat): 13.78 lakh sq ft
- **Palm Walk Mall** (Hybrid retail, Ludhiana): 9 acres
- **Florence** (Residential, Ludhiana): 25 acres
- **Royal Green Realty** (Upcoming, Gurugram & Bahadurgarh): Two projects
